note: schema_type! fixes: cfg twin fields keep their own cfg on From / from_model assignments, relation loads, SeaORM default fns, codec adapters and inline relation types (helpers of twins are named by field index); a multipart DTO no longer requires its bare Vec fields in OpenAPI; From (and the container default) is left out when a source field is not readable from the call site; a serde-mode DTO keeps the source container serde(default); a source path through another crate's import is an error instead of picking a same-named local struct; pub(super) / pub(in ..) fields become pub(crate); garde custom / context paths are re-rooted at the source module; active cfg_attr schema items reach ignore metadata; inline relation types keep a split rename_all; via_rel to columns are normalized against the source model; aliased bare imports in inline modules resolve; gen is emitted raw; nested main.rs / lib.rs are plain module files; module segments keep their case on Windows; alloc::vec::Vec is a repeated multipart part and heapless::Vec is not; default fns named r#x resolve; caches cover missing out-of-tree files and drop circular analyses per invocation.
